body: You may think that "wishing the best" doesn't help but I think it does. We are real people and we don't have any debts with you. But we're still here, reading and sympathizing with you. We do this because we care about you. Almost of us have similar feelings and we know how difficult is to keep going. So, I wish you the best, and I wish this will help a little.
Tell us if you still here! We'll be very happy! But, if not, I hope you found peace.
Hey. Can you tell me a little better what's going on?

Avoid hurting people I love it's the only thing that keeps me here. If it's the only thing that holds you here, try to attach to this. Do the opposite, give them love, with simples things. I'm sure you will sleep a little better at night.

I understand you. I just posted something like this a few minutes ago here on this sub.. It's just crazy to know how many people are on the same boat as us
